dimensions.assessment: Affects VA leadership, specific senior-level employees restricted from certain incentives, and congressional committees receiving briefings.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits the VA from providing specified pay incentives to senior-level employees, and establishes an office to carry out customer service initiatives

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and operational changes for the Department of Veterans Affairs without altering core benefit eligibility for veterans.
dimensions.evidence: establishes the Veterans Experience Office through FY2028 to carry out the key customer experience initiatives of the VA

dimensions.assessment: Limits specific employee pay bonuses and authorizes existing funds for administrative expenses without increasing overall FTE counts.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits the VA from providing certain senior-level employees with a critical skill incentive

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new office within the VA, alters statutory reporting requirements, and amends restrictions on Senior Executive Service incentives.
dimensions.evidence: establishes an office to carry out customer service initiatives of the VA... amends the following

dimensions.assessment: Budget briefing requirements last for three years, and the Veterans Experience Office sunsets on September 30, 2028.
dimensions.evidence: until the date that is three years after the date of the enactment of this Act... terminate on September 30, 2028

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts saved by restricting critical skill incentives.
Number of senior-level employees affected by the pay incentive restrictions.
importance_detail.rationale: The PRO Veterans Act of 2025 requires quarterly budget briefings from the VA, restricts certain senior-level pay incentives, establishes a temporary customer experience office through 2028, and mandates GAO reviews, primarily affecting VA administration and oversight.
